evidence_level: offline independent CPU references only; no RTL simulation or board evidence

fixture_selection.prng: xorshift32: x ^= x<<13; x ^= x>>17; x ^= x<<5, uint32 truncation
fixture_selection.q_k_generation: Q/K use base_seed, in serialized layout order; all signs alternate by dimensions and token, all magnitudes nonzero; late-max K signs align with Q at final token
fixture_selection.timing: Only independent references are used. No DUT or simulator outputs are read, and no fixtures are changed in response to DUT results.
fixture_selection.v_seed_search: per KV group and 32-dimension block: start=base_seed XOR ((group+1)*0x9e3779b9) XOR ((block+1)*0x85ebca6b), uint32; try start+attempt, ascending attempt from zero, skip zero seed; first candidate meeting both oracles' quantization margins and identical scale/Q8 wins
fixture_selection.v_values: token then dimension order: (-1)^(token+dimension+group) * (1+xorshift32()%511)/512, exactly representable FP16

format.descriptor_base: 4 + case_index * 16; identical headers and descriptors in both files
format.expected_layout: context F32 [Hq,D]; scale low16 [Hq*D/32]; Q8 low8 two's-complement [Hq,D]; mathematical context F32 [Hq,D]
format.input_layout: Q F32 [Hq,D]; K/V zero-extended F16 [N,Hkv,D]; mask zero-extended byte [N]
format.word: one 32-bit hexadecimal word per line; readmemh array index is absolute word offset

oracle.arm_q8: each consecutive 32 outputs: d=RNE_F32(amax/127), id=d?RNE_F32(1/d):0; scale=RNE_F16(d); qs=RNE_integer(RNE_F32(context*id)); no clipping
oracle.dot: ascending dimension; separate RNE binary32 product then RNE binary32 add, initial +0
oracle.exp: Decimal 80 and 120 digits, direct integer-ratio RNE binary32; independently checked against math.exp rounded to F32
oracle.mathematical: global stable softmax with exact decoded Q/F16 inputs and unrounded dot; Decimal 50 and 80 precision agree on all exported F32 values
oracle.online: ascending visible token; first=(score,1,V); larger: alpha=RNE(exp(RNE(m-score))), l=RNE(RNE(l*alpha)+1), O=RNE(RNE(O*alpha)+V); otherwise beta=RNE(exp(RNE(score-m))), l=RNE(l+beta), O=RNE(O+RNE(V*beta)); normalize RNE(O/l)
oracle.rtl_exp_distinction: The oracle uses correctly rounded exp, not the RTL's Q48 degree-12 approximation. No bit-for-bit RTL exponential result is assumed. Context is checked with the existing numerical gate, while scale/Q8 remain exact. Per-case interval bounds prove that any context satisfying that gate retains the same raw scale/Q8 for these preselected fixtures; actual RTL compliance still requires simulation.
